verdict.summary: Forward-chained OOS over 7 seasons (878 Y->Y+1 pairs): REM+ predicts next-year RA9 at rho=0.2363 vs raw FIP 0.211, ERA 0.0901, raw WPA 0.101. CI on the rho gap: vs ERA {'mean': 0.1451, 'lo95': 0.0881, 'hi95': 0.2018}, vs raw WPA {'mean': 0.1343, 'lo95': 0.0742, 'hi95': 0.194}, vs raw FIP {'mean': 0.0252, 'lo95': 0.0013, 'hi95': 0.0501}. LEVERAGE BAKE-OFF: leverage-weighting does NOT beat pure REM+ on forward RA9 (best gain within noise); ships as a separate Impact column (best d=0.0, rho=0.2363 vs pure 0.2363). MARKET CHECK: leverage-weighted REM+ aligns better with what teams pay. Shipped VALIDATED: REM+ beats ERA + raw WPA and is not worse than its raw-FIP parent; the leverage-weighted variant does not earn a forward edge, confirming the two-number design (leverage is a deployment/price layer, kept in a separate column).
